name: delprobe-4-dump-after-delete
hint: Is TallyPrime running with a company loaded, and port 9000 open (Exchange > Data Synchronization)? Check http://localhost:9000 in a browser.
note: Stock-item deletability probe, 2026-09-16 -- the run that crashed TallyPrime (finding #22). Issued by an ad-hoc scratchpad script, so 'script' is null; payloads are reproduced in FINDINGS.md #22. Step 1 create failed clean on an invalid PARENT; step 2 confirms nothing was created; step 3 ACTION=Delete on the resulting nonexistent stock item hung and crashed the process (c0000005), so steps 3 and 4 have no response.xml -- the timeout IS the evidence.
